tour.welcomeBody: Your home for hours, pay, and time off — let's take a quick look around.

home.title: Home
home.body: Your week at a glance: hours so far, latest payslip, and anything that needs your attention.

time.title: Time
time.body: Every clock-in and clock-out for this period. Spot a missing punch? Tap to report it from here.

pay.title: Pay
pay.body: Every payslip lands here when payroll publishes. Open one to acknowledge or report a problem.

profile.title: Profile
profile.body: Change your language, manage notifications, and sign out. Notifications keep you in the loop on payday.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Turn these on so we can ping you the moment your payslip is ready or a punch needs attention.

home.submissionHint: Use the buttons above to file a missed-punch fix or a time-off request.
home.notLinkedAccount: Your account is not linked to an employee record.
home.cancelTimeOffConfirm: Cancel this time-off request? You can submit a new one if you change your mind.
home.requestCancelConfirm: Ask admin to cancel this approved time off? It stays approved until they review it.
home.salariedBody1: You're on a salaried plan. Your paystubs and W2 documents appear under <payLink>Pay</payLink>.
home.salariedBody2: Use the "Request time off" button above for vacation or sick days.

pay.discrepancyExplain: Most often this happens on legacy-imported records where the old report's total was copied over but only some of the original punches survived the migration. Ask admin to reconcile if it matters.

notifications.pushDescription: Get pinged on this device when payroll publishes or a missed-punch alert lands. Tied to this browser; revoking notification permission in your OS clears it on the next reconnect.
notifications.notConfiguredTitle: Push notifications aren't set up yet.
notifications.notConfiguredBody: Your admin needs to configure VAPID keys before this device can subscribe. They'll find the setup steps under Settings → Notifications.
notifications.recentDescription: Last 20 alerts sent to your account.
notifications.emptyDescription: Anything we send to you will show up here.
notifications.addToHomeScreenBody: On iPhone/iPad, push only delivers from a Home Screen icon — not a regular Safari tab. Tap the <share>Share</share> button (the square with an arrow), choose <add>Add to Home Screen</add>, then open the app from that icon and come back here to enable.
notifications.errorIosNeedsHomeScreen: On iPhone/iPad, push only works after you Add to Home Screen and open the app from that icon. Tap the Share button (square with arrow) → Add to Home Screen, then open the app from your Home Screen and try again here.
notifications.errorNotSupported: Push not supported in this browser.

onboarding.saveTitle: Save Milo to your Home Screen
onboarding.saveBody: One tap from your home screen, no Safari, no typing. Get instant updates when your payslip is ready.
onboarding.notifyBody: We'll ping you the second a new payslip publishes or you have a missed punch. No spam — just the stuff that matters.
onboarding.errorNeedsHomeScreen: On iPhone/iPad, save Milo to your Home Screen first, then open it from there.
onboarding.errorNotSupported: Push not supported in this browser.
onboarding.instructionsTitle: Save Milo to your Home Screen
onboarding.instructionsBody: Adds a Milo icon next to your other apps. Tap it any time to open Milo without typing a URL.
onboarding.iosStep1: Tap the {shareIcon} Share button at the bottom of Safari.
onboarding.iosStep3: Tap {addBold} in the top-right. Milo lands on your Home Screen — open it from there from now on.
onboarding.androidStep1: Open the browser menu (3-dot icon, top-right).
onboarding.androidStep3: Confirm. Milo shows up alongside your other apps.
onboarding.afterInstall: Once installed, come back to this banner to turn on notifications.

missedPunchReview.approveHintMissingOut: Approve closes the open shift with this clock-out — it does not create a second punch.
missedPunchReview.approveHintMissingIn: Approve sets clock-in on the punch that only had clock-out on file.
missedPunchReview.approveHintFull: Approve creates a punch with both times the employee entered.
